name: od-related-query
description: Development tooling for the OD Related Query WordPress plugin.

scripts.env:seed: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-related-query wp eval-file scripts/seed-sample-content.php
scripts.i18n: npm run i18n:pot && npm run i18n:update-po && npm run i18n:mo && npm run i18n:json
scripts.i18n:json: npm run i18n:json:clean && wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-related-query wp i18n make-json languages/od-related-query-ja.po languages --no-purge --pretty-print --use-map='{"src/index.js":"build/index.js","src/variation.js":"build/index.js"}'
scripts.i18n:mo: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-related-query wp i18n make-mo languages/od-related-query-ja.po languages/od-related-query-ja.mo
scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-related-query wp i18n make-pot . languages/od-related-query.pot --slug=od-related-query --include=od-related-query.php,src,scripts --headers='{"POT-Creation-Date":""}'
scripts.i18n:update-po: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-related-query wp i18n update-po languages/od-related-query.pot languages/od-related-query-ja.po && node scripts/normalize-translation-headers.js
